direction: マリオのような親しみやすいゲームキャラクターの方向を試す

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create an art-directed high-end character illustration exploration for a Japanese elementary-school website TOKKATSU広場. The user clarifies the desired visual language is MARIO: instantly familiar, iconic, exuberant, approachable Nintendo platform-game character appeal, expertly designed silhouettes, bold clean controlled forms, NOT generic AI anime illustration or sentimental picture-book rendering. Use the visual design grammar of Super Mario promotional artwork for ORIGINAL SCHOOLCHILD characters. These are schoolchildren, not Mario characters in costumes. No logos.
Wide 3:2 composition, three scenes side by side in separate loosely connected colorful miniature school settings, each with 3-4 LARGE characters, faces visibly dominate and clearly read at thumbnail size. Exact Japanese headings above the scenes: 「運動会」 「児童会」 「学級会」. No other lettering.
Establish a distinct recurring cast of schoolchildren with 2.5-head-tall proportions, large softly geometric heads, simple oval cartoon eyes with black pupils, boldly shaped eyebrows, small round button noses, clear asymmetric expressive mouths, sculptural single-mass hairstyles with just 3-5 big locks, oversized comfortable shoes, readable mitten-like cartoon hands with coherent thumbs. Deliberate clean anatomy, smooth continuous arms and legs, elastic expressive poses, squash and stretch, strong line of action, distinct silhouettes and playful personality. Three different child face shapes and hairstyles, no clones. Ordinary colorful school clothes. NO enormous sparkling anime eyes, intricate hair strands, eyelash-heavy faces, skin pores, glossy doll skin, photographic textures, cinematic bokeh, generic clipart, soft diffuse rainbow haze. No moustaches or Mario hats.
Scene 1 sports day: two children in red and white sports caps passing a relay baton while running, strong movement readable from silhouette, both faces visible in three-quarter view, a cheering child, curved running-track marking and triangular flags, simplified school behind.
Scene 2 student council: two children in casual everyday clothes leading an outdoor school assembly, one with microphone and inviting gesture, one with a simple illustrated agenda board. Another child responds happily. A small low podium and playful school backdrop; no school uniforms, no adult lecturer.
Scene 3 class meeting: three classmates and a child chairperson discuss around an open semicircle of desks, one hand raised, another child writing a note, chairperson gestures toward structured colorful rectangular cards on a chalkboard. Make every child's face visible, compact warm group interaction. No teacher.
Prioritize iconic character design and face readability over background detail. Strong separated colors: sky blue, grass green, sunny yellow, warm red, cream. Controlled clean environment materials. Each vignette reads as a playful explorable activity zone in the SAME school game world. Excellent hands, simple no-text props, restrained background shapes.
STYLE D — bold 2D official platform-game character illustration / classic Super Mario instruction-manual-inspired ink art. Extremely confident smooth BLACK outlines, thicker silhouette contour with fine internal facial lines. Flat vivid spot colors, only one purposeful cel shadow per form, no gradients or paper texture. Hand-designed strong iconic faces and joyous bouncy poses. Rounded low-detail chunky landscape and props. Off-white background with colorful island-like scene patches. Avoid anime and conventional educational textbook illustration. The image should look like polished playful vector-ready character artwork by an experienced video-game illustrator.
